reviewNotes: Native campus timetable demo. No account, subscription or payment is required for the built-in sample timetable. The isolated sample schedule uses the real date and time; imports and edits apply only to the current demo session and reset after relaunch. Existing personal SwiftData files remain isolated. This build adds a dedicated read-only current-lesson screen for course links from widgets and Live Activities, with an original monochrome classroom illustration and ticket layout. The illustration reflects the selected lesson's before-class, in-class and finished states. Optional school import opens a third-party academic website in an ephemeral WKWebView and needs per-school verification. School credentials are not persisted. NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent supports academic websites that only offer HTTP; ordinary URLSession ATS remains enabled and certificate checks are not bypassed. Local notifications are optional. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets are included. Complete background automatic Live Activity ending remains unverified. Teacher mode and anniversary/countdown-event widgets are not included. The combined build also includes compact island countdown presentation, duplicate activity cleanup, teacher details, system-managed activity colors and imported text annotation cleanup. These do not establish reliable background ending.

zh-Hans.description: 课间册是面向校园的原生课表演示工具。无需登录即可查看样例、编辑课程、体验学校网页导入、考试列表、黑白手绘人物及桌面和锁屏课程组件。课程组件与实时活动的课程入口使用独立的本次课程页面，以课堂入场券呈现课程、教室和时间。本版仍使用独立演示数据：导入与修改仅在本次会话生效，重启恢复样例，已有个人数据保持隔离。学校导入需按各校实际页面验证；实时活动完整后台自动结束仍待完善。教师模式、纪念日和倒数日组件尚未提供。
zh-Hans.whatsNew: 新增「课堂入场券」本次课程页面：原创黑板、课桌、校园小猫，撕边票据、教室门牌与纸飞机上课进度；画面根据本次课程的课前、课中、结束状态变化。请重点测试：桌面/锁屏课程组件、锁屏实时活动和灵动岛的课程入口是否进入正确课程；从冷启动、正在编辑课程时点击、重复点击入口；浅色/深色和大字体。页面仅展示本次课程，不直接打开编辑。仍为演示版，导入和修改重启恢复样例；实时活动完整后台自动结束尚未验证。 同时包含：灵动岛课前倒计时、重复实时活动清理、教师信息与锁屏配色调整，以及导入课程名称和教室尾部注记清理。请一并检查实际设备显示与是否重复出现活动。

en-US.description: A native campus timetable demo with an isolated sample schedule, course editing, optional academic website import, exam lists, monochrome illustrations, and Home Screen and Lock Screen course widgets. Course links open a dedicated read-only lesson ticket with course, room and time information. No account is needed for the sample timetable. Imports and edits last for the current demo session and reset after relaunch; existing personal data remains separate. School compatibility needs per-school verification. Complete background automatic Live Activity ending is still unverified. Teacher mode and anniversary/countdown-event widgets are not included.
en-US.whatsNew: New classroom admission ticket for the current lesson, with original blackboard, desk and campus cat artwork, a torn paper edge, room sign and paper-plane class progress. Artwork reflects the selected lesson's before-class, in-class and finished states. Test course links from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Lock Screen Live Activities and Dynamic Island, including cold launch, an already-open editor, repeated links, light/dark appearance and larger text. The destination displays lesson information without opening the editor. This remains a demo: imports and edits reset after relaunch. Complete background automatic Live Activity ending remains unverified. Also includes the compact island pre-class countdown, duplicate Live Activity cleanup, teacher information, system-managed Lock Screen colors, and removal of trailing academic display annotations from imported names and rooms. Please verify these on a physical device.
